newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco drains 1.852 bln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco drains 1.852 bln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) drained 1.852 billion dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Wednesday.

The bank received bids totalling 2.482 billion dirhams and allocated 1.920 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was less than the 3.772 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 77.35 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on March 26, 1997, the bank added.
